releases.description:
This is a Provider Selection Regime (PSR) contract modification notice, under the Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023. For the avoidance of doubt, the provisions of the Procurement Act Regulations 2024 do not apply to this award. This contract has been formally modified.
National requirement.
Modification approved by ICB Executive Director of Finance and Contracts.
No conflicts of interest were declared.

amendments.rationale:
Need for modification brought about by circumstances which a diligent contracting authority/entity could not foresee: This modification is made in response to external factors beyond the control of the relevant authority and the provider, including but not limited to: 
• changes in patient or service user volume 
• changes in prices in accordance with a formula provided for in the contract documents (for example uplifts in prices published in the National Tariff or index linking) 
but do not render the contract or framework agreement materially different in character.
This modification is permissible in line with Section 13 - 2A and 2B (ii) of The Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023.
